analysis.trigger_accuracy_root_cause: Claude opus-4-6 treats data processing tasks as routine work it can handle natively without skill consultation. Even with aggressive MANDATORY framing, the model does not consult a skill that only contains a stub ProcessData workflow with no specialized tools or scripts. The skill's content (Workflows/ProcessData.md has only placeholder steps) doesn't provide enough value proposition for the model to route to it.
